adjudication_gate: Preserve and self-check both independent returns before any comparison; send every controlled-field disagreement to repo480_bv_adj.

analysis_plan.agreement: Row-level agreement with the frozen adjudicated binary label on all 220 rows, reported separately per stratum; Cohen kappa plus PABAK.
analysis_plan.decision_rule: If the independent stratified estimate covers 0.054, keep the adjudicated rule as the preferred estimate; if it does not, report the boundary as rule-dependent and demote 26/480 to one member of the sensitivity family.
analysis_plan.interval: Wilson two-sided 95% interval with the stratum-C finite population correction
analysis_plan.primary: Stratified P2/P3 prevalence from the independent adjudicated panel, compared with the frozen adjudicated 26/480 = 0.054.
sensitivities: raw panel intersection and union before adjudication

design.coverage_premise: All 26 adjudicated P2/P3 rows lie inside the 70-row raw union, so the union census covers the incumbent numerator exactly; the consensus sample exists to estimate rows the original passes missed rather than to assume that rate is 0.
design.estimator: p_hat = (union_flagged + 410 * consensus_flagged / 150) / 480; the union stratum is a census so only the consensus stratum carries sampling variance, with a finite population correction of 1 - 150/410.
design.goal: Test whether the adjudicated repo480 patch-decidability boundary reproduces under an independent two-pass panel that never sees the prior labels.
design.packet_identity: Reviewer views are the byte-identical frozen packets shown to repo480_r1 and repo480_r2, so any label difference is reviewer variance, not packet variance.
design.sample_size_rationale: With 150 of 410 consensus rows and zero panel-flagged rows, the 97.5% one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound on the consensus-stratum rate is 0.0244, i.e. at most 10 extrapolated rows, which is the same order as the +/-10-row width of the frozen 26/480 Wilson interval.

sampling.presentation_order_rationale: Combined rows are re-ordered by an independent hash domain so stratum membership is not inferable from worklist position.

stratification_rule.raw_consensus_p01: tasks where both raw passes labelled P0/P1; deterministic hash sample
stratification_rule.raw_union_p23: every task where repo480_r1 or repo480_r2 raw-labelled P2/P3; census, no subsampling

label_freeze: This panel produces an independent estimate; it never edits the frozen repo480_available_v1 canonical labels.
